onboarding.lead: No phone number. No email. No metadata. Your identity is a key, generated and stored only on this device.
onboarding.identityTitle:
This is yours.
Nobody else has it.
onboarding.didDescription: Your DID is derived from your public key. It is pseudonymous — share it only if you want on-chain verifiability.
onboarding.identityWarning: Write this down or back it up encrypted. If you lose it, no one — not even us — can recover it.
onboarding.registrationFailed: Registration failed. Check your connection and retry.

home.emptyWorkDesc: Team channels are E2EE. Add a coworker with their Aegis ID or QR to start.
home.emptyPersonalTitle: Your first conversation starts with a shared key.
home.emptyPersonalDesc: No auto-discovery here — we don't use your address book. To talk to someone, exchange Aegis IDs in person, by QR, or via link.
home.deleteMessagesConfirm: Delete all messages with {{name}}? The contact remains.
home.deleteContactConfirm: Delete {{name}} and all their messages? This action cannot be undone.

chat.zeroTrustDesc: The identity key of this contact has changed on the directory server. Since Zero-Trust mode is active, sends and calls have been blocked to protect your privacy against a potential MITM attack.
chat.keyChangedDesc: The identity key of this contact has changed. This may be due to a device change or an interception attempt (MITM). Re-verify their identity before sharing sensitive data.
chat.trustAnywayConfirm: You will accept the new key without verifying in person. Only do this if you fully trust that your contact simply changed devices.
chat.blockedContact: This contact is blocked. Unblock them to send messages.
chat.zeroTrustBlock: Zero-Trust blocked: Key changed. Re-verify the contact.
chat.deleteMessageDesc: This message will be deleted locally.
chat.deleteForAllDesc: This message will be deleted for you and the recipient.
chat.callBlockedDesc: You cannot make calls to a blocked contact. Unblock them first.
chat.callZeroTrustBlockDesc: Calls are blocked because the contact's key changed on the server. Re-verify first.
chat.callSimulatorDesc: Expo Go does not support native WebRTC for real calls. What type of simulated call do you want to start to test the interface?

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.noResultsDesc: Try another term or clear the search.
contacts.emptyDesc: Scan a peer's QR or paste their Aegis ID to start.

profile.title: Profile
profile.multiIdentityDesc: Creation of additional ephemeral identities will be available in v1.0.
profile.createIdentityDesc: This will create an additional isolated identity. Your current identity is not affected.
profile.createIdentityComingSoon: Multiple identity profiles will be available in a future update.
profile.identityCreatedDesc: New isolated identity ({{slotId}}) generated with its own keypair and database.
profile.deleteIdentityDesc:
This will permanently delete your private key, contacts, messages and encrypted sessions from THIS device. Your contacts will not be able to send you new messages until you regenerate an identity.

Continue?
profile.profileSavedDesc: Your Aegis identity details have been successfully updated!
profile.separateIdentities: Separate identities, separate keys. Your contacts can never link them to each other. Tap your profile to edit your information.
profile.galleryPermission: We need permission to access your gallery.
profile.cameraPermission: We need permission to access your camera.
profile.activateWorkDesc: Would you like to generate a dedicated, isolated cryptographic identity for your Work profile? This will create an independent Aegis ID and keypair on your device.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.readReceiptsSub: Confirm when you've read a message
privacy.typingIndicatorSub: Let others see when you're typing
privacy.blockScreenshotsSub: App contents hidden in screen recording
privacy.routeViaTorSub: Hide your IP from AegisLink relays
privacy.torSub: Requires Orbot VPN active on your device
privacy.torOrbot: When active, all relay traffic is routed through the Tor network via Orbot. Your IP is hidden from the relay server.
privacy.auditAlertDesc: AegisLink is fully open source. All cryptographic code can be independently reviewed and verified.
privacy.jurisdictionAlertDesc: AegisLink is developed and operated in Italy.
privacy.modeDesc: Changes the colors while preserving the Vault identity. Fonts, shapes and accents are preserved.

lock.faceIdLabel: FACE ID · KEY ON DEVICE · NEVER LEAVES
lock.maxAttemptsReached: {{max}} failed attempts. The app is locked.

panic.title: Panic mode
panic.heroTitle: If you are forced to open the app
panic.heroDesc: AegisLink can instantly delete your chats, or show an empty account under a duress PIN.
panic.activateDecoyPinSub: Opens a clean account. What others see: nothing.
panic.activatePanicDesc: This will permanently wipe ALL messages, contacts and keys. Confirm?
panic.duressPinModalDesc: Enter a 4 to 6 digit PIN. When this decoy PIN is entered on the lock screen, AegisLink will start simulating a completely clean account with no history.
panic.invalidPinDesc: The decoy PIN must be between 4 and 6 digits.
panic.pinSaveErrorDesc: Could not save the decoy PIN.
panic.duressPinAction: Opens empty decoy account — data preserved
panic.remoteTriggerDesc: Store this link outside the phone (password manager, trusted device). Opening it instantly wipes all data.
panic.regenerateConfirmDesc: The previous link will stop working immediately.

networkError.title: We can't reach any relay
networkError.desc: No network. Your new messages are encrypted and queued until connection is restored. Keys never leave this device.
networkError.emergencyRelayDesc: Tor routing is available in the production version. Make sure you have Orbot installed and active on your device.

groupChat.deleteMessageDesc: This message will be deleted locally.
groupChat.deleteForAllDesc: This message will be deleted for all members.
groupChat.sendOrSchedule: Send — long-press to schedule a post
groupChat.postScheduledDesc: It will be posted to the group automatically at the chosen time.

groups.title: Groups
groups.emptyDesc: Create a group to start encrypted conversations with multiple contacts.
groups.emptyContactsDesc: You need saved contacts to add them to a group.
groups.emptyWorkDesc: Create an encrypted channel for your team. E2EE with MLS, up to 256 members, roles and anonymous polls.
groups.emptyPersonalDesc: Create an MLS encrypted group. Up to 256 members, admin/mod/member roles, private topics, anonymous polls.
groups.joinByLinkDesc: MLS invite links use a QR protocol digitally signed by admins. You can invite your direct contacts by adding them to a group!
groups.joinByLinkModalDesc: Paste the invite link that was shared with you.
groups.joinByLinkInvalidDesc: The link format is not valid. Make sure you copied the full link.
groups.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete this group and all its messages from your device.
groups.errorCreateName: Please enter a name for the group.
groups.errorCreateMembers: Please select at least one member for the group.
groups.permissionDeniedGallery: We need permission to access your image gallery.
groups.permissionDeniedCamera: We need permission to access your camera.

backup.title: Encrypted Backup
backup.setPassDesc: This passphrase is the only key to your backup. We cannot recover it — store it somewhere safe.
backup.enterPassDesc: Enter the passphrase you set when you created this backup.
backup.reEnterMismatch: Re-enter the same passphrase in both fields.
backup.notValidBackup: This file is not a valid AegisLink backup.
backup.notValidEnvelope: This file is not a valid AegisLink backup envelope.
backup.mnemonicExactly32: The recovery phrase must be exactly 32 words.
backup.wordNotInDict: Word "{{word}}" is not in the dictionary.

scheduled.title: Scheduled messages
scheduled.infoDesc: Messages are encrypted and sent at the exact time. Until then they are stored only here, securely on your device.
scheduled.scheduledAlertDesc: Your message to {{name}} will be sent in {{delay}} seconds.

ephemeral.title: Disappearing messages
ephemeral.desc: Messages disappear after the set time.
ephemeral.alertEnabled: Disappearing messages enabled! New messages will delete after {{label}}.

viewOnce.title: View once
viewOnce.sendEphemeralDesc: The recipient can only view it once — after that it is deleted everywhere.
viewOnce.previewDesc: The recipient will be able to view it only <bold>once for 30 seconds</bold>. They cannot save, screenshot or forward it.
viewOnce.processError: Could not process the image securely.
viewOnce.bullet1: EXIF and metadata removed before encrypting
viewOnce.bullet3: E2EE encrypted — the server only sees opaque bytes
viewOnce.cannotForwardNotSaved: CANNOT FORWARD · NOT SAVED TO GALLERY
viewOnce.receivedTitleDefault: A contact sent you a view-once media
viewOnce.receivedDesc: You will see it for 30 seconds. Then it is deleted from the device and the server — it cannot be forwarded or saved.

voiceRecorder.permissionMessage: Microphone access is needed to record a voice note.

location.title: Share location
location.shareDesc: Your location is shared encrypted with {{name}} and automatically deleted when the time expires.
location.sharedSuccessDesc: Your live location has been successfully shared with end-to-end encryption.

poll.title: Create poll
poll.question: Question
poll.anonymityNotice: Votes are not linked to identities. Only the total is published.

workDashboard.title: AegisLink Work
workDashboard.noOrgDesc: Secure enterprise messaging with zero metadata. Create a new org or join an existing one.
workDashboard.revokeDeviceDesc: This will immediately terminate all sessions on this device. Continue?
workDashboard.inviteTokenDesc: Share this token with the new member. It expires in 7 days and can only be used once.
workDashboard.policyEnforced: Policy enforced. Devices require key verification every {{days}} days. Non-compliant devices are automatically suspended.
workDashboard.policyDefault: Policy enforced. Zero metadata by design.
workDashboard.howItWorksStep1: 1. Select a plan and tap "Get Lightning invoice"
workDashboard.howItWorksStep2: 2. Copy the BOLT11 string and pay with any Lightning wallet (Phoenix, Breez, Muun…)
workDashboard.howItWorksStep3: 3. After payment, your wallet shows the payment preimage (32-byte hex). Paste it here.
workDashboard.howItWorksStep4: 4. The server verifies SHA-256(preimage) = paymentHash and activates your subscription.
workDashboard.relaysPrivacyDesc: All traffic between clients and relays is end-to-end encrypted. Relays only route opaque ciphertext — they never see message content, sender identity or timing patterns.
workDashboard.policyDeviceVerDesc: New devices must be approved by an admin
workDashboard.policyKeyRotDesc: Keys are rotated per the policy interval
workDashboard.policyZeroMetaDesc: No logs of IPs, timestamps or message sizes
workDashboard.policyEphemeralDesc: All messages auto-delete after the set interval
workDashboard.policyRotationDesc: All member devices must rotate their session keys every {{days}} days. Non-compliant devices are automatically suspended.
workDashboard.policyReadOnly: Only org admins can modify security policies.

subscription.title: Anonymous subscription
subscription.desc: Subscribe without any identity. Pay with Lightning.
subscription.privacyDesc: Payments are made via the Lightning Network (BOLT11). No email, no name, no credit card. The server only verifies your payment preimage — it never learns who you are.
subscription.howItWorksStep1: 1. Select a plan and tap "Get Lightning invoice"
subscription.howItWorksStep2: 2. Copy the BOLT11 string and pay with any Lightning wallet (Phoenix, Breez, Muun…)
subscription.howItWorksStep3: 3. After payment, your wallet shows the payment preimage (32-byte hex). Paste it here.
subscription.howItWorksStep4: 4. The server verifies SHA-256(preimage) = paymentHash and activates your subscription.
subscription.preimageDesc: After paying the Lightning invoice, your wallet shows a 64-character hex preimage. Paste it below — it proves you paid.
subscription.copiedDesc: BOLT11 invoice copied to clipboard. Paste it in your Lightning wallet.
subscription.invalidPreimageDesc: Must be a 64-character hex string from your Lightning wallet.

lockSetup.pinsDoNotMatch: PINs do not match, start over
lockSetup.verifyCurrentSub: We need to verify your identity

lockSetup.bioUnlockSub: Unlock with biometrics in addition to PIN
lockSetup.autoLockSub: Locks the app when leaving foreground
lockSetup.pinSecureTitle: Your PIN never leaves the device
lockSetup.pinSecureDesc: Saved as a salted SHA-256 hash in system Keychain (iOS) or Keystore (Android). Neither AegisLink nor anyone else has access.

lockConfig.title: Lock screen
lockConfig.appLockSub: Require PIN or biometrics to open

scanQR.instruction: Point camera at an Aegis QR code

verify.instruction: Compare the fingerprints out of band to verify this contact.

firstContact.desc: Share your Aegis ID with this person to connect.
firstContact.verifiedDesc: Their key fingerprints match. What is sent in this chat will only be decrypted by the owner of that key — neither AegisLink nor anyone else.

inviteAdd.title: Invite & add
inviteAdd.desc: Share your invite link to let others add you.
inviteAdd.hubDesc: AegisLink never reads your address book. Choose how to exchange identities.
inviteAdd.scanDesc: Most secure. In-person verification in a single step.
inviteAdd.showDesc: For the peer to scan you — same security level.
inviteAdd.pasteDesc: Paste the contact's 11-character ID. Verify the fingerprint later.
inviteAdd.warnDesc: Any method works to start — but compare the 8 safety words before sending anything sensitive.

attachSheet.title: Attach
attachSheet.cryptoWarning: Everything is encrypted before leaving the device. File EXIF and metadata are automatically removed.

groupAdmin.removeMemberDesc: Do you want to remove this member from the group?
groupAdmin.shareInviteLinkSub: Anyone with the link can request to join

contactDetail.markVerifiedDesc: You confirm that you have compared the words or QR in person and they match your contact's.
contactDetail.revokeVerifiedDesc: Do you want to mark this contact as unverified?

contactDetail.notificationsDesc: Per-contact notification control (mute, mentions-only, custom) will be available in the next version.
contactDetail.notifLevel_mentions_desc: Only alert when a keyword matches
contactDetail.blockWarning: {{name}} won't be able to send you messages. History is preserved.
contactDetail.clearBlockDesc: Delete all messages with {{name}} and remove the contact? This action cannot be undone.

keys.title: Identities & Keys
keys.safetyInfo: Your keys are generated and stored exclusively on this device. They never leave the device and cannot be recovered by anyone — not even AegisLink.
